stem: $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter of circle M, $m(\widehat{CB}) = 130^\circ$ and $m(\widehat{BD}) = 3x + 5 = 80^\circ$, with C and D on opposite sides of B. Complete: $m(\widehat{CBD}) = \ldots$. Drag the points to set the measure of arc CBD.
solution: CB and BD are adjacent arcs.

hints.text: The arc measure is its central angle itself. Check which angle you have set.
Arc CBD passes through B. Check which of the two arcs between C and D you set.
Add the measures of the adjacent arcs.
